name: Amman Mineral Copper Smelter
status_basis: First copper cathode in March 2025; ramp-up completed in April 2026.
notes: 900 ktpa concentrate feed and 830 ktpa sulfuric acid. Investment about US$1.4B; the earlier US$2.1B planning figure is not used. Converted at Rp16,500/USD.

name: Borneo Alumina SGAR Mempawah
status_basis: Phase 1 completed and targeted for full operation in 2025.
notes: Phase 1 is 1 Mtpa alumina; Phase 2 (2 Mtpa) is planned. 60% INALUM and 40% ANTAM. US$900M; converted at Rp16,500/USD. Coordinate is a manual approximate point at Sungai Kunyit, not an OSM match.

name: CATL-CBL Indonesia Battery Cell Plant
operator_name: Ningbo Contemporary Brunp Lygend Co., Ltd.
status_basis: Ground broken on 30 June 2025; first phase 6.9 GWh targeted for 2027.
notes: US$6B covers the full battery integration project (mine, materials, recycling and plant), not just Karawang. Phase 1 is 6.9 GWh, later 15 GWh. JV with ANTAM and IBC. Converted at Rp16,500/USD.

name: Chandra Asri Cilegon Petrochemical Complex
status_basis: Naphtha cracker has operated since 1995; ethylene capacity expanded to 860 ktpa.
notes: The company is also building a 500 ktpa EDC and 400 ktpa caustic soda plant in Cilegon (target 2027); it is not part of this row.

name: Freeport Indonesia Manyar Copper Smelter
status_basis: First copper cathode in 2024; restarted production in September 2026 after the December 2025 outage.
notes: US$3.7B. Design feed 1.7 Mtpa concentrate; cathode output is reported as 480 ktpa by Reuters and 600-650 ktpa elsewhere. PTFI's page describes a 2 Mtpa design; the conflict is recorded. Investment converted at Rp16,500/USD.

name: Inalum Kuala Tanjung Aluminium Smelter
status_basis: Reduction plant has a maximum capacity of 250 ktpa aluminium.
notes: Expansion to 400-600 ktpa is discussed but not committed in a source used here.

name: Krakatau Steel Cilegon
status_basis: Integrated steel plant; company profile gives 3.0 Mtpa slab capacity.
notes: Group rolling capacity is larger; this row covers the Cilegon slab plant.

name: Lotte Chemical Indonesia New Ethylene (LINE)
status_basis: Commercial operations began in October 2025; completion ceremony on 6 November 2025.
notes: Also 520 ktpa propylene, 140 ktpa butadiene and 250 ktpa PP. US$3.95B converted at Rp16,500/USD.

name: PT Angel Nickel Industry
status_basis: Four RKEF lines in operation; 2025 production was 46,429 t of nickel.
notes: Nickel Industries owns 80%. Capacity is 66 ktpa nickel metal following the 2021 expansion; 2025 output was 46,429 t Ni. Coordinate is a manual approximate point in IWIP, not an OSM match.

name: PT Dexin Steel Indonesia
status_basis: Started production in March 2020; first-phase expansion completed in September 2025, taking capacity to 7 Mtpa.
notes: US$2.2B investment; capacity raised from 4 to 7 Mtpa. Converted at Rp16,500/USD. Coordinate is a manual approximate point inside IMIP, not an OSM match.

name: PT Gunbuster Nickel Industry (GNI)
status_basis: Most NPI lines shut by 2026; temporary PKPU debt suspension on 19 June 2026 and 1,800 layoffs in July 2026.
notes: The PKPU is a court-supervised restructuring stay, not liquidation. Management said operations continued in June 2026, but most of the 20 lines had stopped. Capacity 1.8 Mtpa NPI. US$3.0B; converted at Rp16,500/USD. Coordinate is a manual approximate point at Bunta, not an OSM match.

name: PT Gunung Raja Paksi
status_basis: Company profile gives 2.2 Mtpa steel capacity.
notes: EAF-based flat and long steel producer.

name: PT Halmahera Persada Lygend HPAL (Obi)
status_basis: Indonesia's first MHP plant; production started in 2021.
notes: Atlas capacity is 55 ktpa Ni+Co in MHP; the first phase is also reported as 37,260 t Ni plus 4,577 t Co contained in 96,000 t MHP. About US$1B; converted at Rp16,500/USD.

name: PT Huadi Nickel-Alloy Indonesia
status_basis: Six additional RKEF furnaces commissioned from 2020; eight-furnace capacity of 200 ktpa NPI.
notes: Rp6.5T was the 2020 expansion, not total investment. The initial plant predates it; opened_year records the expanded eight-furnace configuration.

name: PT Huafei Nickel Cobalt HPAL (IWIP)
status_basis: Some HPAL lines started in June 2023 and reached target output by Q1 2024.
notes: Also produces about 15 ktpa cobalt in MHP. US$2.08B; converted at Rp16,500/USD. Coordinate is a manual approximate point in IWIP, not an OSM match.

name: PT Indonesia BTR New Energy Material
operator_name: PT Indonesia BTR New Energy Material
status_basis: First phase started production on 7 August 2024.
notes: Phase 2 adds US$299M and doubles capacity to 160 ktpa; not confirmed complete. US$478M converted at Rp16,500/USD.

name: PT Indonesia Tsingshan Stainless Steel (ITSS)
status_basis: Stainless steel complex in production since mid-2017; 1 Mtpa continuous casting capacity.
notes: Part of IMIP, which is a separate estate row. Wood Mackenzie puts the wider Morowali stainless complex at 2 Mtpa in 2017 and 3 Mtpa in 2018; this row covers ITSS's 1 Mtpa line. Coordinate is a manual approximate point inside IMIP, not an OSM match.

name: PT Obi Nickel Cobalt (ONC)
status_basis: Second refinery fully operational with commercial production since August 2024.
notes: Adds 65 ktpa MHP; Harita's combined MHP capacity is 120 ktpa. About US$1.1B; converted at Rp16,500/USD. Coordinate is a manual approximate point at Obi, not an OSM match.

name: PT Obsidian Stainless Steel (OSS)
status_basis: Trial production in February 2020; full capacity reached in 2021.
notes: Integrated ferronickel-to-stainless complex; 2.5 Mtpa stainless steel. Coordinate is a manual approximate point in the Morosi park, not an OSM match.

name: PT OKI Pulp & Paper Mills
status_basis: Mill started production in 2016; current capacity about 2.8 Mtpa pulp.
notes: Original project was 2 Mtpa pulp plus 0.5 Mtpa tissue; current capacity is 2.8 Mtpa. US$2.6B converted at Rp16,500/USD. Coordinate is a manual approximate point at Air Sugihan, not an OSM match.

name: PT Smelting Gresik Copper Smelter
status_basis: Operating since 1998; cathode capacity expanded to 342 ktpa in 2023.
notes: Indonesia's first copper smelter and refinery. Expansion lifted concentrate processing to 1.3 Mtpa and cathode capacity to 342 ktpa.

name: PT Virtue Dragon Nickel Industry (VDNI)
status_basis: Smelter completed in December 2019; 15 RKEF lines produce NPI.
notes: 120 ktpa nickel in NPI, about 800 ktpa NPI alloy. The attached OSS stainless plant is a separate row. Investment about US$1.4B; converted at Rp16,500/USD.

name: PT Well Harvest Winning Alumina Refinery
operator_name: PT Well Harvest Winning Alumina Refinery
status_basis: First phase started in 2016; capacity doubled to 2 Mtpa in 2022.
notes: Smelter-grade alumina. Total investment about US$1.3B; converted at Rp16,500/USD.

name: Pupuk Kaltim Bontang
status_basis: Five urea plants with combined capacity of 2.98 Mtpa.
notes: Also 1.85 Mtpa ammonia across four plants.

name: Vale Bahodopi HPAL Project
status_basis: HPAL plant under construction; the Bahodopi block began mining in 2025.
notes: 60 ktpa MHP; target Q4 2026. Investment about US$1.4B; converted at Rp16,500/USD.

name: Vale Pomalaa HPAL Project
status_basis: First autoclaves arrived in December 2025; line 1 targeted for August 2026 and full capacity by January 2027.
notes: Part of the Indonesia Growth Project. Investment about US$2.7B for the HPAL plant; some sources include the mine and quote US$4.5B. Converted at Rp16,500/USD.

name: Vale Sorowako HPAL Project
status_basis: HPAL project under construction; 2022 sustainability report gives 60 ktpa and a 2027 target.
notes: Investment range US$1.9-2.1B; atlas uses US$2.0B. Converted at Rp16,500/USD.
